method.effectiveContrastPremise: Canvas composites actual computed colors over the solid ancestor chain. Enabled probes reject ancestor opacity or background images. Offline luminance calculation recomputes ratios from RGBA samples for extra probes and all switch surfaces; reused original observation ratios are separately checked against fresh PNG samples.
method.pixelContrastPremise: Original PNGs, integer floor coordinates at recorded provider CSS bounds. Left straight-edge midpoints; midpoint focus outline and neighbors; exact provider thumb bounds for all sizes, center and 3x3 patches. sRGB WCAG relative luminance. Never transform PNGs. Not an exhaustive antialiased edge minimum.

threshold.meaning: Task/shared-helper adjacent-color criterion; this is not a complete WCAG conformance assessment.

premiseRevisions.reason: Left .35/.65 samples fall into rounded pill corners; first primary-color row run is not the center of the on track. These sampling premises were rejected, not reported as product failures.

Flooring fractional top-edge geometry can sample the preceding or antialiased row. The final criterion uses stable straight left midpoints rather than claiming every antialiased pixel is an opaque boundary.

Invalid empty and populated Input; invalid empty and populated grouped input with inline addons; invalid empty and populated grouped textarea with block addons; standalone invalid empty/populated Textarea. Rest/focus pairs in light/dark and both sizes.
Group read-only invite-link input remains unchanged after typing; focus transitions from frame to actionable addon. Populated textarea reply and addon button retain separate focus ownership.
Standalone Textarea read-only/disabled/enabled Availability variants in four theme/viewport contexts. Read-only typing leaves value intact; disabled controls are skipped by keyboard.
Input, InputGroup and Switch disabled native/ARIA behavior and keyboard skip in four contexts. Disabled opacity remains in PNGs and is excluded from enabled-contrast thresholds.

Switch enabled on/off across background/card/muted surfaces in original story assertions/computed observations. PNG composite capture shows the first surface pair; independent size PNGs cover sm/md/lg off/on plus keyboard focus and Space toggle in four contexts.

Textarea ErrorRecovery invalid -> valid -> invalid across four contexts with custom helper/error IDs; caller fixtures for custom Field IDs, explicit aria-errormessage, explicit undefined, caller description/id/name/data-slot/class, missing error element, and valid state.

Supplemental invalid-field observer directly verifies stable before/after focus error IDs, DOM accessible descriptions, associated labels, error visibility and live settings in 32 pairs across all Input/group/standalone modes and four theme/viewport contexts.
coverage.focusOwnership: InputGroup outer frame owns input/textarea focus. Inner outline is none, error chrome/text persist, addon focus uses button ring without keeping frame outline.
coverage.observedLayout: Viewed fields/addons fit their crops at both viewport sizes; phone error/help text wraps. Long read-only URL uses the input native horizontal text viewport. Extra observations recorded no document horizontal overflow in these story contexts.
coverage.callerFixtureScope: Temporary fixture screenshots are attribute diagnostics; neighboring fixture text may appear at crop edges. Caller-controlled id/data-slot/class values are asserted, not offered as production layout or generated-label association proof.

measurements.supplementalCaptureUse: 64 additional original-observer PNGs retained by the final association run; contrast and viewed-PNG counts above refer to the first two runs. These 64 repeats were not separately opened or offline pixel-measured.

darkOffThumb.assessment: The reported narrow margin reproduces independently in the fresh actual pixels and composited colors. All sm/md/lg center patches pass; do not generalize this margin to other rendering engines or arbitrary consumer surfaces.

measurements.errorFocus: 104 accepted field rest/focus pairs have a separate keyboard outline. Minimum sampled focus-vs-rest ratio is 3.8123868860924404 light and 4.4224844631379465 dark. Invalid paired samples preserve value, red border and text color; focus is not inferred only from native text selection.
measurements.limits: Point/patch samples, not every antialiased edge pixel. Pixel minima differ from effective token ratios because of inset shadows and rasterization. No complete text contrast audit, focus-area conformance proof, timing/animation assessment or screen-reader announcement measurement is claimed.

sourceReview.finding: Adds the same boundary/outline repairs and conditional aria-errormessage inferred from invalid Field context only when its registered described-by tokens contain the error ID. The inferred attribute precedes caller spread; caller explicit values and undefined override it. cn/class merging and final data-slot/id/name attributes preserve caller precedence.

sourceReview.callerCaveat: Overriding a native id alone does not retarget FieldLabel. The diagnostic caller-id fixture verifies precedence, not label association; callers must coordinate Field IDs/labels. This behavior predates this patch.

sourceReview.finding: Read the full relevant source/story changes and unchanged assertion helper. Stories check DOM roles/state, effective boundaries, keyboard behavior and distinct invalid outline. Shared contrast helper composes colors over actual ancestors. Assertions and stories were left intact.

observationsRequiringManagerContext.observed: While invalid, Textarea ErrorRecovery has aria-errormessage="review-validation-error" and aria-describedby="review-validation-error review-validation-helper". Both resolve to the same visible error text. Ark FieldError error-text connector supplies aria-live="polite". On recovery, aria-errormessage disappears and describedby keeps only review-validation-helper; clearing restores the error links.
observationsRequiringManagerContext.source: packages/ui/src/components/textarea.tsx plus installed @ark-ui/react Field hook/error-text behavior, pinned through yarn.lock and hashed in final-identity.json. Supplemental DOM snapshots also confirm aria-live="polite" on each error.
observationsRequiringManagerContext.inference: Some screen reader/browser combinations may announce the same error through descriptive and error-message relationships and/or the live region. This review did not run a screen reader, so duplicate speech is neither confirmed nor ruled out. Do not strip Ark description or relax assertions on this inference alone.
observationsRequiringManagerContext.next: Manager accessibility proof should test supported screen-reader/browser combinations during invalid focus, live validation and recovery. Implementation remains G-2756 if a failing outcome is confirmed.
